prior_art_boundary: Nurowski, arXiv:2609.10751 (2026-09-09), independently proves that the antipodal quotient of the Schur 24-line configuration is Reye. This certificate supplies the project-internal extraspecial-group/coset derivation and explicit dual-typed isomorphisms to the pre-existing Q4/tomotope and 24-cell Reye models.
theorem: Quotienting the Schur extraspecial coset geometry by the central phase Z(E) pairs its 32 triple points and 24 lines 2-to-1 and yields the typed incidence dual of the project-native Reye configuration.
